title: Unit 8 Consolidation: Concession & Counter-Argument
goal: Consolidate concessive clauses (aunque, a pesar de que, por más que, aun cuando, reduplicativas) and analyze Alejo Carpentier's 'El reino de este mundo'.
grammar: síntesis de subordinación concesiva, refutación y contrapunto retórico

items: Govern indicative and subjunctive complements in concessive clauses (aunque, a pesar de que, si bien).
Express intensive effort and extreme degree with 'por más que' and 'por mucho que'.
Formulate high-stakes hypothetical scenarios with 'aun cuando' and 'aun a riesgo de que'.
Deploy universal reduplicative formulas (hagas lo que hagas, pase lo que pase).
Analyze magical realism, tyranny, and human dignity in Alejo Carpentier's classic masterpiece.
I can alternate between indicative and subjunctive after 'aunque' based on factuality vs. hypothesis.
I can use formal emphatic connectors like 'a pesar de que' and 'si bien' in argumentative prose.
I can express futile efforts using 'por más que' and 'por mucho que'.
I can employ reduplicative subjunctive patterns to assert unwavering principles.
